ayahs.en: About what are they asking one another?
About the great news -
That over which they are in disagreement.
No! They are going to know.
Then, no! They are going to know.
Have We not made the earth a resting place?
And the mountains as stakes?
And We created you in pairs
And made your sleep [a means for] rest
And made the night as clothing
And made the day for livelihood

ayahs.tl: Wa banaina fauqakum sab 'an shi daada
ayahs.en: And constructed above you seven strong [heavens]
And made [therein] a burning lamp

ayahs.tl: Wa anzalna minal m'usiraati maa-an saj-jaaja
ayahs.en: And sent down, from the rain clouds, pouring water

ayahs.tl: Linukh rija bihee habbaw wana baata
ayahs.en: That We may bring forth thereby grain and vegetation
And gardens of entwined growth.
Indeed, the Day of Judgement is an appointed time -

ayahs.ar: يَّوۡمَ يُنۡفَخُ فِي الصُّوۡرِ فَتَاۡتُوۡنَ اَفۡوَاجًاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Yauma yun fakhu fis-soori fataa toona afwaaja
ayahs.en: The Day the Horn is blown and you will come forth in multitudes

ayahs.tl: Wa futiha tis samaa-u fakaanat abwaaba
ayahs.en: And the heaven is opened and will become gateways

ayahs.tl: Wa suyyi raatil jibaalu fa kaanat saraaba
ayahs.en: And the mountains are removed and will be [but] a mirage.
Indeed, Hell has been lying in wait
For the transgressors, a place of return,
In which they will remain for ages [unending].

ayahs.ar: لَا يَذُوۡقُوۡنَ فِيۡهَا بَرۡدًا وَّلَا شَرَابًاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Laa ya zooqoona feeha bar daw walaa sharaaba
ayahs.en: They will not taste therein [any] coolness or drink
Except scalding water and [foul] purulence -
An appropriate recompense.
Indeed, they were not expecting an account

ayahs.tl: Wa kazzabu bi aayaa tina kizzaba
ayahs.en: And denied Our verses with [emphatic] denial.

ayahs.tl: Wa kulla shai-in ahsai naahu kitaa ba
ayahs.en: But all things We have enumerated in writing.

ayahs.tl: Fa zooqoo falan-nazee dakum ill-laa azaaba
ayahs.en: "So taste [the penalty], and never will We increase you except in torment."
Indeed, for the righteous is attainment -
Gardens and grapevines
And full-breasted [companions] of equal age
And a full cup.

ayahs.ar: لَا يَسۡمَعُوۡنَ فِيۡهَا لَغۡوًا وَّلَا كِذّٰبًاۚۖ‏
ayahs.tl: Laa yasma'oona fiha lagh waw walaa kizzaba
ayahs.en: No ill speech will they hear therein or any falsehood -
[As] reward from your Lord, [a generous] gift [made due by] account,

ayahs.ar: رَّبِّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا الرَّحۡمٰنِ لَا يَمۡلِكُوۡنَ مِنۡهُ خِطَابًاۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Rabbis samaa waati wal ardi wa maa baina humar rahmaani laa yam likoona minhu khi taaba
ayahs.en: [From] the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Most Merciful. They possess not from Him [authority for] speech.

ayahs.ar: يَوۡمَ يَقُوۡمُ الرُّوۡحُ وَالۡمَلٰٓئِكَةُ صَفًّاؕࣗۙ لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُوۡنَ اِلَّا مَنۡ اَذِنَ لَهُ الرَّحۡمٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابًا
ayahs.tl: Yauma yaqoo mur roohu wal malaa-ikatu saf-fal laa yata kalla moona illa man azina lahur rahmaanu wa qaala sawaaba
ayahs.en: The Day that the Spirit and the angels will stand in rows, they will not speak except for one whom the Most Merciful permits, and he will say what is correct.

ayahs.ar: ذٰلِكَ الۡيَوۡمُ الۡحَقُّۚ فَمَنۡ شَآءَ اتَّخَذَ اِلٰي رَبِّهٖ مَاٰبًا
ayahs.tl: Zaalikal yaumul haqqu faman shaa-at ta khaaza ill-laa rabbihi ma-aaba
ayahs.en: That is the True Day; so he who wills may take to his Lord a [way of] return.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّا٘ اَنۡذَرۡنٰكُمۡ عَذَابًا قَرِيۡبًا ࣢ۚۖ يَّوۡمَ يَنۡظُرُ الۡمَرۡءُ مَا قَدَّمَتۡ يَدٰهُ وَيَقُوۡلُ الۡكَافِرُ يٰلَيۡتَنِيۡ كُنۡتُ تُرٰبًاࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: In naa anzar naakum azaaban qareebaiy-yauma yan zurul marr-u maa qaddamat yadaahu wa ya qoolul-kaafiru yaa lai tanee kuntu turaaba
ayahs.en: Indeed, We have warned you of a near punishment on the Day when a man will observe what his hands have put forth and the disbeliever will say, "Oh, I wish that I were dust!"
